name: Raw or Sautéed Whole Mushrooms (Chitin Cell Wall Stricture Warning)
whyItWorks: Mushroom cell walls are made of chitin, a tough polymer identical to crustacean shells. Humans lack chitinase enzymes, so mushroom chunks remain rubbery, sponge-like, and intact throughout transit, creating obstruction risks in strictures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stricture Warning: Avoid whole or sliced button, cremini, or portobello mushrooms. If using mushrooms for umami flavor, use clear mushroom broth or finely pureed mushroom soup in remission.
watchOuts: Indigestible chitin chunks can swell and lodge in narrowed intestinal segments.
